name: AMD iGPU · Use swangle rendering (example)
author: ApkStart
description: On some AMD integrated GPUs with older drivers, -gpu host passes the emulator check but crashes ~10s after guest boot (log only shows 'AEHD is operational'). Pinning the backend to swangle avoids the crash at a slight frame rate cost.

notes: If graphics look normal but games lag, set Graphics Quality to 540x960 in Settings
Once verified, set enabled to true or remove that line to activate automatically
